purpose: Provide computed certificates for the caller-declared direction_error_bound: an L2 absolute error budget of the processed output inside a fixed evaluation window, in input amplitude units

composition.e_in: Input formation error. Zero only for an exact-construction certificate (the truth array and the input array are the same constructed object). FDTD outputs are numerically unresolved and must not receive a budget.
composition.e_op: Operator arithmetic error. Per-element bounds derived from counted IEEE roundings (unit roundoff u = eps/2): each floating add/subtract/multiply/divide contributes at most half an ulp of its result; math.fsum is correctly rounded and contributes at most half an ulp of the sum. Measured |float64 - fsum-path recomputation| plus the counted slacks is the certificate.
composition.e_svd: Subspace perturbation part for leading-SVD removal. Per kept singular triplet: residual r_i = max(||X v_i - sigma_i u_i||, ||X^T u_i - sigma_i v_i||) computed on an fsum path, spectral gap gap_i to the nearest neighbouring singular value, sinTheta_i <= sqrt(2) r_i / gap_i (Wedin / Davis-Kahan sin-Theta theorem, standard matrix perturbation theory of the Golub & Van Loan type), component output perturbation b_i = r_i + 2*sqrt(2)*sigma_i*sinTheta_i. If any gap_i <= 0 or sinTheta_i >= 1 the bound is vacuous and the budget for that row is missing with reason svd_subspace_bound_vacuous.
composition.e_diff: Differential cancellation: e_diff <= e_1 + e_2 (triangle inequality). The amplification factor (||a||+||b||)/||a-b|| is reported as a risk diagnostic only.
composition.e_ref: Reference error is a separate caller responsibility and is never folded into the output budget.

allowed_evidence: exact_construction: constructed arrays where truth and input are the same object; e_in = 0
exact_recomputation: math.fsum correctly-rounded path plus counted half-ulp slacks
standard_perturbation_bound: Wedin/Davis-Kahan sin-Theta and Weyl eigenvalue bounds, applied to computed residuals and gaps
caller_declared_input_budget: an explicit nonneg input bound supplied with its own evidence
forbidden_evidence: machine epsilon times an arbitrary constant
empirical factors or values that merely look small
two-grid FDTD differences presented as an FDTD error bound

sigma_max.svd_component_removal: 1 as an orthogonal-projection removal; nonzero input error through an SVD step is not certified and yields missing budget
sigma_max.difference: sum of the two operand budgets

propagation.chain_rule: e_total <= sigma_max(O2) * e_in1 + e_arith2 applied step by step; per-element arithmetic bounds are carried per step, earlier-step bounds are carried as conservative full-array L2 scalars

scope_limits: The budget certifies numerical identifiability of the output direction only; it certifies no physical accuracy.
Not a GPR detection threshold, not a training label, not an industry acceptance standard.
FDTD-sourced arrays keep missing budgets until independently resolved.
